dct_description_sm: This dataset was generated to examine the extent of the Ellesmere Island ice shelves over time.  Data from 13 observation years were combined to examine ice shelves and ice tongues along the northern coast of Ellesmere Island.  The dataset also contains polygons for other ice types and can be used to track environmental change in the Arctic.  Precursors of this dataset have been used in Mueller DR, Crawford A, Copland L, Van Wychen W (2013) Ice Island and Iceberg Fluxes from Canadian High Arctic Sources. Northern Transportation Assessment Initiative, Innovation Policy Branch, Transport Canada, Ottawa and in the 2015, 2011 and 2008 editions of the Atlas of Canada, Natural Resources Canada.For more information, please consult the following:  Mueller DR, Copland L, Jeffries MO (2017) Changes in Canadian Arctic ice shelf extent since 1906. In: Copland L, Mueller DR (eds) Arctic Ice Shelves and Ice Islands, Springer SBM, Dordrecht

dct_title_s: Northern Ellesmere Island ice shelf and ice tongue extents, 1906-2015
